captions.detailed: A minimalist, compact bedside air purifier with a uniform matte grey finish. It is designed as a vertical rectangular cuboid housing. A thin, dark slit-like opening is visible at the very bottom edge of its front face, representing the slot for a slide-out filter tray.
captions.instruction: Generate a compact bedside air purifier with a vertical cube-like housing and a bottom-mounted filter tray that slides out along a prismatic joint.
captions.factory: Construct the main body of the purifier as a solid Box primitive representing the housing. Define a second, smaller Box primitive for the sliding filter tray. Assemble them together using an ArticulatedObject structure, defining a prismatic joint at the base of the housing with translation limits along the depth axis.
